_about: What verify/from-json.js cannot fill mechanically for big-demons-baby, written by hand and read by it on every run (from-json.js --write gives the same data.js again). The list was first imported from New Recruit’s PDF (verify/import-nr.js); these are the values data.js had then that its JSON export and GW’s pages do not give, each as data.js showed it and as its review signed it off: source (the day the PDF was exported; the export has none), units.<id>: na (why an ability does nothing in this list), notes (an FAQ or a rules note under an ability), kwNote (where a keyword comes from), short (the short name), srcNote (a note on the sources), kwOnly and partialRules (which model has a keyword or a core ability only some models of the unit have, where GW’s pages do not say it mechanically).

source.why: the day New Recruit’s PDF of this list was exported (verify/sources/nr/big-demons-baby.txt), from which the list was first imported; the JSON export carries no date

daemon-prince-of-khorne.why: short: the name the unit screen and the lists show for the Daemon Prince of Khorne, as data.js has always shown it (GW's datasheet name is long for a phone line).

na.Forwards, For Blood!: Not leading a unit in this list

master-of-executions.why: Forwards, For Blood! works only "While this model is leading a unit"; the Master of Executions leads no unit in this list (New Recruit's export: no Leading association).

lord-on-juggernaut-khorne-berzerkers.kwNote: Battleline, Berzerkers, Faction: World Eaters, Grenades, Infantry come from the led Khorne Berzerkers; Faction: Blood Legions comes from Disciple of Khorne on the Lord on Juggernaut (“The bearer has the Deep Strike ability, and it has the BLOOD LEGIONS Faction keyword instead of the WORLD EATERS Faction keyword.”).
lord-on-juggernaut-khorne-berzerkers.why: kwNote: Faction: Blood Legions comes from Disciple of Khorne ("… it has the BLOOD LEGIONS Faction keyword instead of the WORLD EATERS one"), the Lord on Juggernaut's enhancement; Deep Strike is the Lord on Juggernaut's alone (the same enhancement), so the unit cannot use it (24.09).
